light_description: Romanian-developed analog 808-style overdrive combined with MIDI amp-channel switching and multiple clipping modes; later catalog state is documented after the company relocated operations to Vienna.
Jordan Ziff signature mini overdrive derived from the TS8-MS, with expanded clipping, low-end, dry/wet, and dry-EQ controls.
Op-amp fuzzstortion with switchable clipping, boost, and bright/dark voicing; historical 2019-2020 references establish the small-builder lineage.
One-knob Haxan variant with hybrid silicon/LED clipping and maximum-gain voicing.
Mutated fuzz/distortion with selectable gain/type behavior and bias-starve textures, documented as an early signature Stomping Stones design.
Experimental noise unit that can function as standalone fuzz/distortion; explicitly positioned as a continuation of the earlier Pest Tattern release.
Discontinued Soviet-style sustainer/fuzz product preserved as a historical catalog state.
Discontinued experimental dirt/noise pedal retained as a historical named product state.
